say: Her body is a rigged 3D model, posed entirely by the exhibit's own code.
She is the Animated Woman model by Quaternius, but none of the model's own animations are used.
Every frame, her pose is described by a handful of numbers: the height of her hips, the angles of her thighs and knees, how far she leans and nods, and where her arms are.
Those numbers become bone rotations. Her legs are solved in 3D from her real hip joints, so that each foot lands exactly where it belongs.
Her hands came rigged, but the fingers never bent. Now each finger curls around an axis worked out from the hand's resting pose.
A single grip value takes her hand from fully open to a closed fist.
